linkedinCompany.name: Trillsverse
linkedinCompany.tagline: Creative, technical, research, and cultural ecosystem spanning software, music, AI architecture, identity systems, and public knowledge infrastructure.
linkedinCompany.about: Trillsverse is an independently built ecosystem founded by John Brajer. It connects interactive software, music and media, worldbuilding, identity architecture, AI systems, structured knowledge, and experimental research into a coherent public stack. The primary runtime is Trillsverse Gate at trillsverse.com, with public canon and artist infrastructure at lultrills.com.

crunchbase.shortDescription: Connected creative and technical ecosystem spanning software, AI architecture, music, identity systems, worldbuilding, and structured public knowledge.
crunchbase.longDescription: Trillsverse is an independently built ecosystem founded by John Brajer. It combines public software, music and media, worldbuilding, identity systems, AI architecture, structured knowledge, and research experiments into a connected set of public products and knowledge surfaces.

productHuntGate.tagline: An immersive living gateway connecting music, identity, worldbuilding, and AI systems.
productHuntGate.description: Trillsverse Gate is the interactive runtime of the Trillsverse ecosystem. Visitors move through a living world of rooms, identity pathways, public transmissions, music-linked experiences, and experimental intelligence systems rather than browsing a conventional static website.
productHuntGate.launchRule: Submit only when the current public Gate experience is the product being intentionally launched; do not use Product Hunt as a generic company listing.

f6sWellfound.name: Trillsverse
f6sWellfound.oneLiner: A connected creative-technology ecosystem combining interactive software, AI architecture, identity systems, music, worldbuilding, and structured public knowledge.
f6sWellfound.description: Trillsverse is an independently built ecosystem founded by John Brajer. The stack connects public web software, immersive experiences, music and media, machine-readable canon, identity architecture, and experimental AI / continuity systems. Rather than treating those as disconnected projects, Trillsverse is designed as one interoperable ecosystem with public runtime, research, and cultural layers.
f6sWellfound.founderBio: John Brajer is the founder and architect behind the Trillsverse ecosystem, working across software, AI architecture, creative systems, research, music, and public knowledge infrastructure.

orcid.biography: Founder and systems architect working across AI architecture, continuity systems, creative technology, structured public knowledge, identity architecture, and cross-domain research through the Trillsverse ecosystem.
orcid.worksRule: Add only stable public research artifacts, manuscripts, preprints, papers, DOIs, or other defensible scholarly outputs. Do not turn product marketing pages into research works.
